frame_format: Each command is sent as two bytes: [code, code XOR 0xFF]. The drone rejects any frame where the second byte is not the inverse of the first. Heartbeat (0x01) is sent at 10 Hz. If the heartbeat stops the drone holds level and altitude after 0.3 s, descends at 0.2 m/s after 1.0 s, and switches the motors off after 3.0 s or on touchdown (requirement R5). KILL is the only instant stop. Planned for the real firmware: a sequence byte so repeated frames can be ignored.
rules: A command is only sent if the smoothed match is for that gesture AND its confidence is at or above that command's min_confidence for the whole hold time.
Body gestures override hand gestures. KILL overrides everything and is sent as a burst of 5 identical frames.
TAKEOFF is only accepted when the drone is ARMED. ARM is only accepted while disarmed on the ground, with a live heartbeat.
HOVER_LOW and LAND need the drone to be flying. NUDGE_FWD, NUDGE_BACK, YAW_360, FOLLOW_ON and FOLLOW_OFF need it to be hovering.
After landing the drone disarms itself and must be armed again.
Keyboard kill (K, Esc or Space), ARM/DISARM and the heartbeat failsafe work independently of gestures.
